content:
AirPods Pro 3 continues to enjoy a 25% discount, AirPods Max 2 is reduced by $100, and weekend deals keep coming. Today's "Lunch Break" headline from 9to5Toys is the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Air on the market, back up to $1,099 (a $200 discount) at the official Apple Refurbished Store, available in three colours — this model usually sells out fast. We also have the MacBook Neo with the latest pricing slashed by up to $120, the Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the Natural or Black Milanese Loop band down nearly $100 on Amazon, and the latest 240W woven Beats USB-C cable on sale at Amazon's lowest price of $18 (40% off) with Prime shipping. Be sure to keep an eye on the still-running 2026 Best Buy Back to School deals as well — read on for more details.

Summer AirPods deals continue: Max 2 down $100, AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off, starting from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) $149 (original price $179)
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) $119 (new original price $179) — Renewed Premium

Best Buy updates 2026 Back to School deals: TVs under $500, Bose down $130, Apple products, Ninja kitchen appliances and more

Cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Air back up to $1,099 ($200 off), available in three colours via the official Apple Refurbished Store

The official Apple Refurbished Store has always been a great place to save money, as retail prices on the current MacBook lineup have already been hiked. However, stock for the Pro lineup and the cheapest M5 MacBook Air configuration fluctuates constantly — this morning we spotted all three colours of the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Air in stock, priced at $1,099 — $200 below the original price.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store is currently selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 512GB of storage for $1,099, with free shipping. The deal was still live at the time of writing, with Midnight, Starlight and Sky Blue models available.

These products come with:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligibility to purchase AppleCare
  • Only sold after going through Apple's strict refurbishment process

What you're looking at right now is the cheapest configuration in the current M5 MacBook Air lineup, which retails new for $1,299. Today, the Apple Refurbished Store is offering it $200 below the new price — the best deal we can find on the cheapest model in the current-generation lineup.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (new original price $1,299)
  • Midnight, Starlight and Sky Blue

This is the Apple Refurbished Store, which arguably offers the best-quality refurbished MacBook Air on the market, but how does it compare with current new retail prices?

Amazon is currently listing this configuration close to its original price, with only the Silver model slightly lower at $1,240. Although this product has sold for less in the past, since the price hike we haven't seen Amazon sell it for below the new price of $1,149 — and even then, that was only during a flash sale roughly a month ago.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop band down nearly $100 on Amazon

I think I can safely say these two smartwatch combinations are arguably the most beautiful in the world, and they're now down nearly $100 on Amazon — that's the Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with the Natural Titanium or Black Titanium Milanese Loop band.

While the cheaper $100-off Ocean Band version is already gone, Amazon is now selling the Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop in Natural or Black Titanium for $799.99, with free shipping.

These two configurations, equipped with the gorgeous woven-steel Milanese Loop, were originally priced at $899 and are now down nearly $100 in this Amazon deal:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (original price $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (original price $899)

Apple is widely expected to unveil its next-generation Ultra wearable next month, but with RAMageddon already spreading to the iPad and MacBook lineups, the new Apple Watch could be the next victim of price hikes. The current lineup is unaffected for now, but since they're essentially mini computers worn on your wrist, the Ultra 4 or Series 12 could be next to take a hit at any time.

Of course, we wouldn't blame anyone for wanting to wait until the September event to see what else Apple has up its sleeve, but these products could see price hikes in less than a month.

The same situation may apply to the Series models, which are also currently $100 off on Amazon:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (original price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (original price $429)

Grab the latest 240W woven Beats USB-C cable at Amazon's lowest price of $18 with Prime shipping (40% off)

Pick up the black 240W 10-foot Beats woven USB-C cable while it's still at its all-time low of $18 with Prime shipping.

Amazon is currently selling the latest 10-foot Beats 240W USB-C woven cable for $18.03, with free shipping available for Prime members or orders over $35.

These 2026 new models offer higher power delivery specifications, originally priced at $30 — admittedly a bit steep for a 10-foot premium USB-C cable. But at 40% off the original price, I think everyone should own one or two of these high-quality, stylish cables, whether for on the go or at home.

Today's lowest-priced option is the Bolt Black model; other options include Navy at $19, Surge Stone down to $20.85 after applying the coupon on the deals page, and the red model slightly under $24.

As mentioned above, this is the latest model, with power delivery boosted dramatically from the previous generation's 60W all the way up to 240W, and the cable length extended to 10 feet. It retains the same tangle-resistant woven design — "More durable, more convenient. Say goodbye to tangles, knots and wear, and enjoy a fully upgraded charging experience."

Amazon restocks 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular model, down $100, deals from $299

Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand drops back to its Prime Day all-time low (35% off)

I tried and reviewed this product earlier this year when it launched, and Anker's 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become a daily essential for me — in my everyday carry, travel bag and home charging setup. Now back on sale at nearly 35% off, it's the perfect time to pick one up, matching Amazon's all-time low price.

Anker's official Amazon store is currently selling the latest 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger for $99.97, with free shipping.

Originally priced at $150, this 3-in-1 charger features a MagSafe charging pad with up to 25W output, and is now nearly 35% off, available in Phantom Grey/Black and Bright White.

This week's deal is similar to ones previously mentioned, matching Anker's summer clearance and this year's Prime Day pricing.

Although this charger is small and portable, it has a bit of weight to it, allowing it to sit securely on a desk or nightstand — equally excellent whether used as a stationary desktop charger or carried on the go.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Belkin's brand-new compact 100W USB-C MacBook GaN charger with 5-foot cable for just $25
  • Charge all your desktop devices for just $60 — SABRENT 252W 8-port charging station (all-time low)
  • Baseus 20,000mAh 100W laptop charger with dual built-in cables for just $33 (58% off)
  • Acer woven USB/Thunderbolt 4 Type-C cable supporting 240W charging and 8K video transmission for just $16
  • Anker 140W 4-port MacBook charger with smart display, today's exclusive $56
  • Top pick: brand-new Schlage Home Key Sense Pro smart lock with Ultra Wideband auto-entry
  • KeySmart transparent "Ghost" SmartCard Find My wallet tracker drops back to Amazon's lowest price
  • Spigen compact MagSafe iPhone organiser pouch/EDC pocket pouch for just $27
  • Anker 5-port Nano travel adapter for "over 200 countries worldwide" for just $20

Apple Refurbished Store MacBook Neo at its lowest price, up to $120 below original

Aside from the MacBook Air and M5 MacBook Pro lineups, Apple's latest more affordable MacBook Neo has also faced price hikes recently, but you can dodge the price hike through the Apple Certified Refurbished Store — the MacBook Neo sells from $689 on Amazon, but you can get it from the best source — the Apple Refurbished Store — starting from $599, with full Apple warranty.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store offers all MacBook Neo configurations at the lowest prices we've been able to find from equally reputable sources, with full Apple warranty and Apple's "rigorous" refurbished quality certification.

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (new original price $699)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (new original price $799)

Although the Apple Refurbished Store product pages don't seem to display any specific deal badges, every model is at least $100 below the new suggested retail price — the 512GB version with the Touch ID keyboard is actually $120 below the new original price, and $20 below its previous pricing.

Yes, they're refurbished, and these prices are just adjusted back to (or very close to) the original suggested retail price — but don't forget we're talking about the lowest prices on the cheapest MacBook in the current-generation lineup.

For some people, saving $100 to $120 isn't enough to outweigh concerns about buying refurbished, which is understandable, but this is no small amount, and we're talking about the best-quality refurbished products bought directly from Apple.
